scope: POC steric analysis for Ar- context (ortho substitution counts)

computed_features.description: Number of detected Ar-* anchor sites in the molecule (from templated Ar-* atomic features).
List of ortho substitution counts (0/1/2) for each detected Ar-* anchor site.

compute.definition: Ortho position counted as substituted if the ortho ring atom has total H count == 0 (blocked by substituent, fusion, or hetero).

computed_features.description: Maximum ortho substitution count across Ar-* anchor sites.
Sum of ortho substitution counts across Ar-* anchor sites.

notes: This layer is computed from RDKit graph analysis, anchored on Ar-* sites detected via templated atomic features (e.g., Ar-Br, Ar-CHO, Ar-OTf).
The same code path works for Ar-Br and Ar-CHO because the Ar- anchor atom is found via atom-map :1 in the templated SMARTS.
